answer: The finality of attestations only counts when the attestator is established, so a fresh cluster of aliases cannot push any transaction to finality until it has spent many epochs proving honesty. The key insight is that coordination itself leaks: the more unified a farm is, the more easily its shared style or timing betrays it. The effect is that voting power tracks real contribution, so a flood of accounts cannot outvote a smaller set of genuinely established participants. Consider a crystal as the anchor of the cost.
